summary: All three named factories (sessionservice.host, terminal.console, terminal.__main__._make_client) are imported and invoked; token resolution runs the shared production loader (TaskServiceClient -> environment_token -> load_tokens, same loader the service uses) against a run-unique write token that exists only in the on-disk credential file referenced by env, so hardcoded or stale tokens fail; the mock transport returns 401 for any other bearer and the test asserts 200 plus exact Authorization headers, proving authenticated protected calls.
